title: Rebooking Tax Credit Scale (Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes)
content:
A rebooking tax credit is set against the companion's taxes and fees on a Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes booking. It follows the companion booking entries on the certificate or pass, the booking being charged included.

| Companion booking entries on the certificate or pass, this booking included | Rebooking tax credit |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | 6 USD |
| exactly 2 | 3 USD |
| a single one | nothing |

Every booking entry on the certificate or pass counts, including bookings later cancelled.

**Hypothetical cases.** The first booking on a certificate earns nothing; a rebooking after one earlier booking earns 3 USD; a fourth booking on a pass earns 6 USD.
